item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Medication. Taking it consistently matters more than taking it perfectly. Tie your dose to something that already happens every day, like your morning routine, so you aren't relying on memory or willpower. If you miss one, don't double up. Just return to schedule and check your prescriber's guidance if you're unsure. Notice how you feel, and keep track so you can report accurately. Action: set a daily dose reminder on your phone right now.
